description: User input changes the structure of a query because it was concatenated into the SQL text.
`$1`, `?` or `@name` in the SQL text; the driver sends the value separately, so it is always data.
``sql`...${value}` ``: a function receives the literal parts and the values apart, which lets libraries generate placeholders.
A table or column name. It cannot be a parameter, so it must come from a whitelist or pass strict validation.
Postgres idiom that matches a column against an array sent as a single parameter; replaces `IN (...)` lists.
`sql.raw`, `knex.raw`, `$queryRawUnsafe`: APIs that insert text verbatim. Safe only with constants.
